theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (θ : Eucl n → ℝ), LocallyIntegrable θ volume → ∀ (x₀ : Eucl n) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → (∀ a : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ ball x₀ ρ → ∀ j : Fin n, ∫ x, θ x * fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume = 0) → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (ball x₀ ρ), θ x = c
